jobs.title: Senior Project Manager- Dairy
jobs.description:
Description

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of new and remodel of dariy construction projects. This role ensures projects are executed safely, profitably, on time, and within defined scope and quality standards. The position focuses on tactical project execution, project team leadership, client communication, subcontractor coordination, and overall project profitability while supporting operational consistency and company standards. The Senior Project Manager also maintains strong oversight of project performance and ensures full compliance with company, safety, and regulatory requirements.

This position does require travel to our job sites.

Requirements

Lead and manage new and remodel construction projects from initiation through completion.
Oversee project schedules, budgets, timelines, project tracking, billing, work in progress reporting, subcontractor coordination, staffing, material planning, and overall project execution.
Support Account Managers in defining project scope and assist Project Managers and Jobsite Superintendents with leadership, communication, issue resolution, and project execution.
Review estimates, buyout documentation, contracts, permits, specifications, and project scopes prior to project startup.
Develop, maintain, and monitor project schedules, tracking systems, Gantt charts, and internal reporting processes.
Manage project documentation, contracts, and reporting systems to ensure accurate and timely records.
Monitor project performance against scope, budget, schedule, profitability, quality, and company standards.
Ensure compliance with OSHA, insurance, customer, contract, and company requirements.
Lead issue resolution efforts related to project execution, scheduling conflicts, subcontractor performance, and customer concerns.
Coordinate with Accounting, Purchasing, and Operations teams to support project execution and financial reporting.
Support quality control, risk management, operational consistency, and successful project delivery.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
Provide project updates and reporting to leadership while supporting continuous improvement and best practices across teams.
All other duties assigned.

Skills And Abilities

Ability to lead and support Project Managers and Jobsite Superintendents across multiple projects.
Demonstrate strong leadership, accountability, professionalism, and communication skills.
Maintain focus on tactical project delivery, operational consistency, and customer satisfaction.
Work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with diverse groups.
Strong ability to schedule, multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Maintain a high level of organization, attention to detail, and project management accuracy.
Manage large-scale, complex construction projects while supporting quality, safety, and compliance standards.
Apply strong financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills to support project performance and profitability.
Maintain professional written and verbal communication with customers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.
Support company safety initiatives and reinforce OSHA, customer, and company compliance.
Drive accountability for project-level performance, execution standards, and overall project success.

Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction, Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience required.
5+ years of experience in construction project management, exceeding $5M in revenue, with experience leading multiple projects.
Strong knowledge of construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, subcontractor management, and project financials.
Professional Engineer license preferred, or ability to obtain.
Agricultural construction experience, particularly swine and/or dairy, is preferred.
Proficiency in engineering and construction management practices, project management software, Microsoft Office, and construction reporting systems.
Knowledge of OSHA regulations, safety standards, and construction compliance requirements is required.
Experience operating or working around common construction equipment and tools, including telehandlers, skid loaders, hand and power tools, and PPE.
Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Proven experience in construction or engineering project management.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to eligible full-time employees, including:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match up to 4%
Paid vacation, accruing from day one
Paid sick time annually
6 paid holidays per year
Short-term and long-term disability insurance
Life insurance
Paid parental and bereavement leave
Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
Employee referral bonus program

Salary Description

$105,000-135,000

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Salesforce Experience Required, Salesforce Certificate Preferred)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Provides subject matter expertise and leadership for program management activities within Provider Network - with heavy use of Salesforce. Supports programmatic business needs across department and/or cross-functional areas, including programs design, implementation, administration, governance, workflow analysis, process improvements, vendor management, policy and playbook development and maintenance, best practices, resource allocations and special projects.

Essential Job Duties

Manages the design, implementation, delivery, and ongoing operations of respective business program(s) and services.
Leads end-to-end program delivery by establishing goals, scope, and success measures aligned with organizational priorities.
Develops and maintains governance frameworks to ensure consistent, compliant, and effective program management practices.
May oversee financial stewardship of program budgets - ensuring proper prioritization and alignment of resources to achieve desired outcomes.
Partners with executive sponsors and functional leaders to ensure program objectives are met and value is realized across business units.
Drives performance measurement and reporting, including dashboards, key performance indicators (KPIs), and post-implementation reviews to track outcomes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
Ensures well-documented policies, workflows, program controls, internal and third-party practices, playbooks and best practices for respective program(s).
Collaborates with legal, compliance, information technology (IT), and other cross-functional teams to ensure governance standards are upheld.
Tracks performance metrics and ensures value realization from deployed solutions.
Coordinates recurring meetings to support governance framework and decision-making processes.
Oversees portfolio management and/or initiative-specific programmatic changes and project management.
Collaborates with key stakeholders to support dissemination and adoption of program guardrails, processes, best practices, etc.
Routinely reviews program collateral to ensure current and accurate reflection of business needs.
Promotes consistency in planning, communication, and execution across initiatives.
Champions organizational change management by ensuring effective stakeholder engagement, communication, and adoption of new processes or technologies.
Maintains and evolves program documentation, playbooks, and best practices to reflect current business needs and lessons learned.
Identifies opportunities/gaps and provides recommendations on program enhancements to applicable leaders.
Creates business requirements documents (BRDs), test plans, requirements traceability matrices, user training materials and other related documentation.
Generates and distributes required business/programmatic reporting.
Facilitates special functional/departmental projects.
May provide specialized training and support to new and existing staff as needed.

Required Qualifications

At least 6 years of progressive program and/or project management experience, with increasing levels of responsibility in a complex, matrixed organization, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
Proven experience leading large-scale or multi-functional programs within healthcare, managed care, or a similar regulated environment.
Strong operational process improvement and change management experience.
Advanced project management experience/skills.
Data analysis skills/experience.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with competing priorities.
Experience managing budgets and resource plans for business/strategic initiatives.
Ability to work cross-collaboratively across a highly matrixed organization.
Strong verbal/written/presentation communication skills, and ability to influence at all levels of the organization.
Advanced Microsoft Office suite (including Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Visio), and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong Salesforce experience
Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
Health care/managed care experience.

jobs.title: Sr. Implementation Manager, Health & Benefits (Client Onboarding, Remote)
jobs.description:
Join Us!

Take the next step in your journey at Inspira Financial.
Guided by our mission to enable better health and greater wealth, we help businesses and individuals thrive today, tomorrow, and into retirement by strengthening and simplifying the health and wealth journey.

Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. Learn more at inspirafinancial.com.

Our values shape how we show up every day. We Lead with Heart
by acting with compassion, empathy, and doing what's right; Cultivate Trust
through integrity, transparency, and accountability; Aim Higher
by never settling for what's expected and continually raising the standard; and Win Together
by collaborating inclusively to achieve the best outcomes.

Our growth and culture haven't gone unnoticed -- we've been recognized on Crain's Fast 50 and Inc. 5000 for remarkable growth, and named to Built In's 2025 Best Places to Work and Gallagher's 2022 Best-In-Class Employer for our workplace culture and benefits.

Don't meet every single requirement? That's okay. We know growth comes from people who are willing to learn and challenge themselves, not just check every box. If you're energized and inspired by meaningful work, continuous development, and being part of a team that turns collective effort into real impact, we want to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

Our office locations are designed to bring people together, foster collaboration, and build meaningful connections. While some roles are based at one of our office locations, remote status and role locations are subject to change, and relocation is not provided.

Job Summary & Responsibilities

The Sr. Implementation Manager will report to the Sr. Manager, Client Management in the CDB Client Services Department. This role is responsible for coaching, training and mentoring team members, assisting with the development, reviewing, and updating of policies and desktop procedures, and discussing, testing, and implementing new product offerings and new software applications. Through verbal and written communications, the ideal incumbent will develop, strengthen, and maintain a positive relationship with our clients and firm associates. This role is also responsible for providing focused service from pre-sale consultation through initial post-sale client administration fostering strong, long-term partnerships with customers and consulting community. This role will direct all aspects of customer benefit plan installation for new and existing high profile, large, complex customers of PayFlex's products and services. The incumbent will develop and execute an implementation strategy consistent with customer expectations. Ultimately creating, managing and tracking detailed project plans and issue logs outlining required actions, responsible parties and assigned target dates associated with the delivery of the services and projects.

Act as the single point-of-contact for benefit plan implementation; mediates and coordinates resolution of all project deliverables and implementation related issues
Ensure implementation strategy is administered in accordance with all performance guarantee arrangements
Partner with all key stakeholders (i.e., sales/service staff, consultants, plan sponsors, and other internal business units) to proactively identify and address critical implementation issues ensuring customer expectations are consistently satisfied or exceeded
Evaluate impact of client-requested exceptions and develops reasonable alternatives to satisfy client’s needs while minimizing impact on systems and operations; Identifies, communicates and tracks cost sensitive items not included as part of the standard process
Collaborate on review, analysis and development of recommendations for the design of complex account and benefit structures based on client’s objectives and PayFlex’s systems, administration and reporting requirements
Participate in high profile client finalist meetings representing the capabilities of the organization’s implementation services process; identifies opportunities for cross sales and account rounding of additional PayFlex products and services throughout the implementation process
Effectively manage implementation team dynamics and provides direction/coaching to fellow team members ensuring success of the overall implementation process; engages team members to follow-through on their responsibilities and tasks
Assist the Manager in monitoring activities such as:
Meeting established service levels
Designing and testing of new product offerings and new software applications
Providing backup support for team members and supervisors
Maintain a positive work atmosphere with the team and internal departments
Assist in developing, updating, and reviewing internal Institutional Client Success, Client Onboarding policies and desktop procedures
Utilize sound judgment to escalate issues that may require intervention of the Manager
Prepare team statistics and reports
Manage special projects
Suggest and implement improvements to internal processes
Other duties as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications

Years of Experience:

5-7 years of experience . Degree:
Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Communications, Finance, or related field . Certification: N/A . Skills & Abilities:
Strong relationship and communication skills
Bilingual language skills preferred
Possess a high level of knowledge regarding IRAs and applicable IRS code
Action oriented - should be motivated by challenging opportunities and thrive in fast paced environments
High level of composure - must be cool under pressure and in challenging situations and respond in a patient and professional manner
Operate efficiently with a high degree of accuracy
Consistent, sound decision making capabilities - must make consistently good decisions using blend of knowledge, experience and analysis
High level of ethics and values - must act in accordance with an appropriate set of core beliefs and within Inspira's personal code of conduct.
Experience in solving complex issues, both independently and in a collaborative team environment
Excellent analytical skills with a proactive nature
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word (including mail merge) and Outlook
Experience with Salesforce CRM and Trust Accounting Systems preferred
Strong collaboration skills

Pay Range

$75,700-$83,000 per year

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation for this position will vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. The compensation package may also include incentive and bonus opportunities.

Inspira provides industry-leading benefits including, but not limited to: healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, paid time off, parental leave and an employee assistance program.

jobs.title: Project Manager Ontwerp & Werven
jobs.description:
Onderneming

Als Project Manager Bouwprojecten staat u in voor de volledige organisatie en A‑Z‑opvolging van complexe infrastructuurprojecten (renovatie, verbouwing, nieuwbouw) binnen de gebouwen van de Europa Ziekenhuizen. U begeleidt alle fasen van het project: van de planning met de betrokken diensten, via de haalbaarheidsstudie, het voorontwerp en ontwerp, tot de uitvoering en de ingebruikname, terwijl u erop toeziet dat de dagelijkse ziekenhuisactiviteiten optimaal kunnen blijven doorgaan.

De Europa Ziekenhuizen, geaccrediteerd door JCI, zijn een referentieziekenhuis voor Brussel en omgeving. Als meertalig algemeen ziekenhuis bieden wij een volledig zorgaanbod aan op onze beide sites (St-Elisabeth in Ukkel en St-Michiel in Etterbeek/Europese Wijk) en onze twee poliklinieken (Bella Vita Medisch Centrum in Waterloo en Inkendaal).

Elke dag zetten onze 300 specialisten en 1800 medewerkers zich in om kwalitatieve, veilige en moderne zorg te verlenen aan onze 2500 dagelijkse patiënten, binnen een hedendaagse en duurzame infrastructuur.

Functie

U bespreekt de projecten die u worden toevertrouwd en fungeert als interface tussen de studiebureaus en de eindgebruikers
U staat zelf in voor het technisch ontwerp, de aanpassing en het uittekenen van plannen (CAD/CAO) voor de projecten die intern worden beheerd.
U controleert de technische oplossingen die door de ontwerpers en ingenieurs worden voorgesteld.
U staat in voor de administratieve opvolging van de projecten (stedenbouwkundige vergunningen, milieuvergunningen, …).
U volgt het budget van elk project op.
U bewaakt de voortgang van de projecten op basis van de planning zoals vastgelegd. Bij afwijkingen doet u optimalisatievoorstellen om de oorspronkelijke deadlines te halen.
U werkt actief samen met de verschillende diensten van de Europa Ziekenhuizen om een correcte weergave van de realiteit op het terrein te garanderen.
U herleest en valideert de lastenboeken die door de studiebureaus worden opgesteld.
U stelt lastenboeken op voor projecten die niet aan studiebureaus worden toevertrouwd, in samenwerking met de aankoopdienst.
U staat in voor het aanvragen van prijsoffertes (werken, leveringen of diensten) voor opdrachten van beperkte waarde, met naleving van de wetgeving inzake overheidsopdrachten.
U werkt mee aan het opstellen van de opdrachtdocumenten, de opstart van de plaatsingsprocedure en de technische analyse van de offertes. Daarnaast volgt u de volledige procedure van de overheidsopdracht voor het toegewezen project nauwgezet op, in nauwe samenwerking met de dienst Aankoop, en rapporteert u hierover aan de Manager Projecten & Engineering.
U ziet toe op de naleving van de geldende wetgeving (veiligheids‑ en gezondheidscoördinatie, …) in samenwerking met de preventieadviseur.
U volgt de lopende projecten op en rapporteert hierover (documentatie, projectgeschiedenis, ROI…) aan de Manager van de dienst Projecten & Engineering.
U beheert de werven van de u toevertrouwde projecten: u controleert de opvolging, neemt deel aan werfvergaderingen als vertegenwoordiger van de Bouwheer en ziet toe op de correcte uitvoering van de werken.
U zorgt ervoor dat dringende acties, noodzakelijk voor de continuïteit van de ziekenhuisactiviteiten, zonder uitstel uitgevoerd kunnen worden, ook buiten vooraf geplande werkonderbrekingen.
U neemt actief deel aan de voorlopige opleveringen in het kader van de ingebruikname van de betreffende zones en de overdracht naar de onderhoudsteams.
U coördineert en organiseert interne verhuisbewegingen met de hulp van de technische dienst.
U volgt de actualisatie van plannen op en controleert de as‑built dossiers vóór het voorstel tot voorlopige oplevering.
U bevordert de informatiedoorstroming tussen de verschillende betrokken partijen.
U zorgt voor een regelmatige rapportering aan uw hiërarchische leidinggevende over elk project, met gedetailleerde informatie over budget en planning.
U vertaalt de strategie van onze ziekenhuizen in de dagelijkse projectwerking.

Profiel

Ingenieur‑architect of architect; een specialisatie in bouw is een troef.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring met projectbeheer binnen bouw/renovatie.
Een grondige ervaring met gespecialiseerde gebouwtechnieken en met renovatie, aanpassing en inrichting van binnenruimtes.
Ervaring in de ziekenhuissector is een meerwaarde.
Tweetalig Frans–Nederlands; kennis van het Engels is een pluspunt.
Kennis van de principes en structuur van succesvol projectbeheer.
Analytisch inzicht.
Sterke interpersoonlijke vaardigheden, leiderschap en coachingcapaciteiten.
Operationele en pragmatische aanpak van projecten.
Vermogen om problemen op te lossen en beslissingen te nemen.
Stressbestendigheid en capaciteit om snel te beslissen in kritieke situaties.
Beheersing van CAD/CAO‑tools en de Office‑suite en in staat zijn om zelfstandig plannen te ontwerpen en uit te tekenen.

Aanbod

Wij bieden u een contract van onbepaalde duur, voltijds, binnen een modern, innovatief en kwaliteitsgericht ziekenhuis

Naast Een Baremische Verloning (IFIC 17) Met Jaarlijkse Anciënniteitsstijging, Een Eindejaarspremie En Een Grote Werkzekerheid, Geniet u Onder Meer Van

Werken in een ziekenhuis met JCI- accreditatie, de garantie voor een toewijding aan kwaliteitsvolle zorg, patiëntveiligheid en professionele teams
Een DKV hospitalisatieverzekering in België en in het buitenland
Voorkeurtarieven voor medische zorg in onze ziekenhuizen voor u en de mensen van hetzelfde huishouden
Interne en externe opleidingen
Gratis taalopleiding in groep of immersie
Telefoonabonnement betaald door de werkgever na het slagen voor een tweetaligheidstest
Een deel van de kosten van de aangeboden maaltijden wordt betaald door het ziekenhuis
1 extra dag anciënniteitsverlof per 5 jaar, zonder maximumlimiet
Terugbetaling vervoerskosten (openbaar vervoer, fiets, auto)
Exclusieve voordelen dankzij Benefits@Work op aantrekkelijke merken, waarmee u het hele jaar door bespaart
Welzijnsprogramma en organisatie van sportieve uitdagingen en gratis groepslessen
De mogelijkheid tot gedeeltelijk telewerken

Interesse in deze functie ? Solliciteer via onze website.

Diversiteit, in al haar dimensies, is een kernwaarde binnen de Europa Ziekenhuizen. Wij zijn ervan overtuigd dat geslacht, afkomst, leeftijd, seksuele oriëntatie, levensfilosofie of handicap elementen zijn die deel uitmaken van onze individualiteit en de kracht van onze teams.

jobs.description:
Position Location:
This role supports our Cypress, CA branch location, which serves customers throughout the greater Los Angeles, CA area. This position will be required to report into our customer site in Rosemead, CA about 1/day a week or as needed.

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. We're improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation. We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That's why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn't just about improving buildings; it's about creating perfect places that improve people's lives.

Transform the everyday with us!

The Senior
Project Manager
position requires the coordination and delivery of multiple, simultaneous projects considered small to medium in complexity with financial impact between $250K and $7M. The Project Manager has fiscal responsibility for all project facets, including project billing, job cost reporting, and overall customer satisfaction.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will:

Facilitate the execution of project/program solution plan for clearly defined sub-projects or sub-programs.
Be responsible for delivery of results for the respective process steps.
Guide technical or administrative staff.
Act as a functional process resource on projects or programs.
Contribute to continuous improvement plan.
Perform active role in maintaining functionally focused client relationships.
Be responsible for several projects of varying size.
Obtain PM@Siemens certification for C Projects ($2.5M).
Review project specifications, drawings and project-specific documents to establish project intent.
Develop and maintain a project schedule and coordinates needs with the project team. Identify time-sensitive installation needs.
Manage the requisition of supplies and materials to complete projects.
Review plans and specifications and participate in project cost reviews.
Assist Operations Manager in the solicitation and contracting of subcontractors.
Conduct an orientation for project technicians and provide project documentation, including scope of work, drawings, applicable specifications, application-engineered drawings, project contacts, etc.
Track resources and project progress.
Document project events that impact the schedule, scope of work, and project efficiency.
Pursue project-specific change-order opportunities.
Coordinate and pursue project-specific billing; coordinate with Accounting team and Operations Manager.
Schedule project-specific commissioning resources and provide commissioning documentation.
Expedite the return of project-specific mark-ups for as-built development.
Complete project-specific close-out documentation.
Effectively manage and coordinate subcontractors to meet scope, scheduling, and financial requirements.
Adhere to local, corporate, and OSHA safety policies and procedures; report unsafe conditions and actions.

You will make an impact with these qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

Associate degree
Must be able to demonstrate ability to work in a team environment providing dedicated support to our customers
Experience with Microsoft Office and Microsoft Project
Verbal and written communication skills in English
SIA CSPM certification preferred
Technical experience in the commercial security access/CCTV industry
3+ years of experience managing projects
Knowledge of industry-standard security communication protocols
Must be 21 years of age and possess a valid driver's license with limited violations; must meet eligibility requirements to participate in Siemens' fleet vehicle program
Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering degree
5 + years of technical experience in the security access/CCTV industry

jobs.description:
Société

En tant que Project Manager Travaux vous serez en charge de l’organisation et la gestion de A-Z des projets d’infrastructure complexes (rénovation, transformation, nouvelles constructions), réalisés au sein des bâtiments des Cliniques de l’Europe. De la planification avec les services concernés, en passant par l’étude de faisabilité, l’avant-projet, le projet, le suivi et la mise en service, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des activités journalières de l’hôpital.

Les Cliniques de l’Europe, accréditées JCI, forment un ensemble hospitalier de référence pour Bruxelles et ses environs. En tant qu’hôpital général multilingue, nous offrons des soins globaux, et ce, sur nos deux sites hospitaliers (Ste-Elisabeth à Uccle et St-Michel à Etterbeek) et nos deux polycliniques (Bella Vita Medical Center à Waterloo et Inkendaal).

Nos 300 médecins spécialistes et nos 1800 membres du personnel utilisent chaque jour leurs compétences au bénéfice de nos 2500 patients quotidiens pour poser de manière efficace un diagnostic précis, offrir un traitement adapté et leur garantir une approche personnalisée, dans le respect de chacun. Pour ce faire, nous utilisons des technologies médicales de pointe, dans une infrastructure moderne qui nous permet d’offrir à chaque patient des soins de haute qualité en toute sécurité et dans le plus grand confort possible.

Fonction

Vous êtes enclin à discuter des projets qui vous sont confiés et servez d’interface entre les bureaux d’étude et les utilisateurs finaux.
Vous assurez vous-même la conception technique, la modification et le dessin des plans (CAO/DAO) pour les projets gérés en interne.
Vous vérifiez les solutions techniques proposées par les auteurs de projet et ingénieurs dans le cadre de ces projets.
Vous assurez le suivi administratif des projets (permis d’urbanisme, permis d’environnement,…).
Vous assurez le suivi budgétaire de chaque projet.
Vous vérifiez le bon avancement des projets sur base des plannings définis. En cas de dépassement, vous faites des propositions d’optimisation pour rattraper les délais initialement prévus.
Vous collaborez activement avec les différents services des Cliniques de l'Europe afin de rendre compte au mieux de la réalité du terrain.
Vous relisez et validez les cahiers des charges transmis par les bureaux d’étude.
Vous rédigez les cahiers des charges pour les projets non confiés aux bureaux d’étude en collaboration avec le service achat.
Vous assurez la demande d’offre de prix (travaux, fournitures ou services) dans le respect des marchés publics pour les marchés à faible montant.
Vous participez à la rédaction, au lancement, à l’analyse techniques des offres et assurez le suivi rigoureux de l'ensemble des procédures de marchés publics du projet confié, en étroite collaboration avec le service des Achats et en rapportez au Manager du service Projets & Ingénierie.
Vous assurez le respect des législations en cours (coordinateur sécurité santé,…) en partenariat avec notre conseiller en prévention.
Vous suivez les projets en cours et faites rapport à leur sujet (documentation, historique du projet, ROI…) au Manager du service Projets & Ingénierie.
Vous gérez les chantiers des projets qui vous sont confiés : vous vérifiez le suivi, participez aux réunions de chantier comme représentant du Maître de l’Ouvrage et contrôlez la bonne exécution des travaux.
Vous veillez, dans certains cas, à l’exécution sans tarder d’actions urgentes pour la poursuite de l’activité hospitalière, indépendamment de période de pause préalablement planifiée en accord avec les services.
Vous participez activement aux réceptions provisoires dans le cadre de la mise en service des zones concernées et en vue de la passation aux équipes de maintenance des Cliniques.
Vous coordonnez et organisez les déménagements internes avec l’aide du service technique.
Vous assurez le suivi de la mise à jour des plans et vérifier les dossiers as-built transmis avant la proposition d’accord de la réception provisoire.
Favoriser la transmission des informations entre les différents intervenants.
Assurer un reporting régulier à son supérieur hiérarchique sur chaque projet avec détails du suivi budgétaire et planning.
Vous traduisez la stratégie de nos hôpitaux dans la gestion des projets au quotidien.

Profil

Ingénieur architecte ou architecte, la spécialisation en construction est un atout.
Vous disposez au minimum de 5 ans d’expérience en matière de gestion de projets dans le domaine de la construction / rénovation.
Vous disposez d’une solide expérience dans les techniques spécialises du bâtiment ainsi que le domaine de la rénovation, de l’adaptation et l’organisation des espaces intérieurs.
L’expérience dans le secteur hospitalier est une plus-value.
Bilingue : français – néerlandais, et la connaissance de l’anglais est un atout.
Connaissance des principes et de la structure d’une gestion de projets fructueuse.
Esprit analytique.
Fortes aptitudes interpersonnelles, aptitudes à diriger et coach dans l’âme.
Gestion opérationnelle et pragmatique des projets.
Capacité à résoudre les problèmes et à prendre des décisions
Résistance au stress et capacité à prendre des décisions rapides en milieu critique.
Maîtrise des outils CAO/DAO et de la suite Office et une aptitude à concevoir et dessiner des plans de manière autonome.

Offre

Nous Vous Proposons Un Contrat à Durée Indéterminée, à Temps Plein, Au Sein D’un Hôpital Moderne, Innovant Et Orienté Qualité. En Plus D’une Rémunération Barémique (IFIC 17) Assortie D’une Évolution Annuelle, D’une Prime De Fin D’année Et D’une Grande Stabilité D’emploi, Vous Bénéficierez Notamment De

Un travail dans un hôpital accrédité JCI, gage d’un engagement dans la qualité des soins, la sécurité du patient et le professionnalisme de nos équipes
Une assurance hospitalisation DKV en Belgique et à l’étranger
Des tarifs préférentiels pour les soins médicaux dans nos hôpitaux pour vous et les personnes vivant à votre domicile
Formations internes et externes y compris spécialisations et master complémentaires pertinents
Des cours de langues gratuits (cours collectifs ou immersion)
Un abonnement téléphonique pris en charge par l’employeur après réussite d’un test de bilinguisme
Une contribution au coût des repas
1 jour de congé d’ancienneté supplémentaire tous les 5 ans, (sans limite)
La prise en charge des frais de transport (abonnements transports en commun, vélo, voiture)
Des avantages exclusifs grâce à Benefits@Work sur des marques attractives, permettant de profiter de réductions tout au long de l’année
Un programme bien-être incluant défis sportifs et cours collectifs gratuits
La reprise intégrale de l'ancienneté dans une fonction similaire
Possibilité de bénéficier d’un leasing vélo via la conversion d’une partie de la prime de fin d’année

Intéressé(e)? Postulez directement via notre site internet!

jobs.description:
W2 only, no C2C, must be authorized to work in the US (both now and in the future).

Cybersecurity Program Manager (Contract To Hire) - Hybrid in Madison, Wisconsin. Apply now for this opportunity at Carex!

Carex is partnering with a Insurance industry partner to hire a Cybersecurity Program Manager to turn cybersecurity assessment findings into an executable, measurable, and governed transformation program. This role will build the roadmap, metrics, governance, and operating discipline required to manage a complex, multi-workstream cybersecurity transformation within a federally regulated healthcare environment.

The Cybersecurity Program Manager will provide dedicated program management capacity to Enterprise Security leadership, translating identified security gaps into prioritized remediation efforts and ensuring initiatives are sequenced, owned, measured, and aligned with regulatory obligations. The environment operates under federal and healthcare security requirements, including FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, HIPAA, and independent information security program evaluations conducted under Section 912 of the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act.

Success in this role means establishing a transformation program with a sustainable operating cadence, producing executive and board-grade reporting, improving visibility into maturity and risk reduction, and ultimately transitioning the established program to an internal Project Management Office.

What You'll Do

Own program management for the cybersecurity transformation portfolio, including planning, sequencing, dependency management, milestone tracking, and critical path management.
Build and maintain a multi-year cybersecurity transformation roadmap, integrated program plan, and RAID log.
Convert identified cybersecurity assessment gaps into a single, prioritized, owned, and dependency-mapped remediation register.
Normalize and validate security gaps with named owners and map remediation activities to relevant NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, and applicable Section 912 control areas.
Design, build, and operate a cybersecurity metrics and reporting framework that measures maturity improvement and risk reduction using available organizational data.
Produce executive, leadership, and Audit Committee reporting materials, including board-grade cybersecurity transformation reporting.
Establish and operate lightweight program governance, including forums, agendas, decision capture, accountability mechanisms, and follow-through without creating unnecessary administrative burden.
Coordinate transformation activities across Enterprise Cyber Resilience functions spanning cyber risk and assurance, business enablement, compliance, trust and architecture, and threat management.
Align the cybersecurity transformation roadmap with the annual Section 912 audit cycle so remediation activities can be efficiently planned, executed, and evidenced.
Build a resource and capacity model that supports evidence-based staffing and budget decisions.
Establish a program charter and sustainable governance model that enables clear ownership, decision-making, and execution.
Develop and manage a wave-sequenced, multi-year transformation plan that reflects priorities, dependencies, capacity constraints, regulatory obligations, and risk.
Ensure metrics and reporting operate through repeatable collection and reporting cycles using live data.
Return meaningful capacity to Enterprise Security leadership by independently driving program operations, coordination, reporting, and follow-through.
Maintain appropriate separation between transformation program management and operational cybersecurity responsibilities, including audit ownership, security architecture and engineering decisions, incident response, security tool administration, vendor operations, and control approval responsibilities.
Prepare and execute comprehensive knowledge transfer and transition of the established transformation program to the internal Project Management Office.

What You'll Bring

Minimum of 8 years of program or project management experience, including at least 5 years specifically managing cybersecurity programs.
Demonstrated ownership of at least one cybersecurity transformation or security maturity improvement program from assessment findings and roadmap development through execution.
Working fluency in the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and NIST SP 800-53, including the ability to independently interpret security control findings.
Experience operating within FISMA, HIPAA, federal healthcare, or similarly regulated security environments.
Experience building cybersecurity metrics, Key Risk Indicator (KRI) frameworks, and related measurement programs and operating them through repeated reporting cycles.
Demonstrated experience producing cybersecurity or transformation reporting consumed by executive committees, Audit Committees, boards, or comparable senior leadership groups.
Experience delivering complex programs in regulated environments subject to external audits and assessments.
Strong program governance, risk management, dependency orchestration, critical path management, and change control capabilities.
Ability to translate cybersecurity assessment findings into structured, prioritized, measurable, and actionable transformation initiatives.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills across technical, business, executive, and compliance audiences.
Experience leading complex transformation initiatives through ambiguity and competing priorities.
Experience transitioning an established program to an internal PMO or similar delivery organization.
Direct experience supporting a Medicare Administrative Contractor, federal healthcare contractor, or another FISMA-regulated organization is preferred.
Familiarity with CMS information security requirements and the MMA Section 912 evaluation process is preferred.
Familiarity with CMMC is preferred.
CISSP, CISM, or CRISC certification is preferred.
Proficiency across multiple execution methodologies, including Agile, with familiarity with scaled delivery frameworks preferred.
PMP, CSM, SAFe, LeSS, PgMP, and/or PfMP certification is preferred.

For a strategist who is equally comfortable setting direction and executing in the details, this role offers the scope, visibility, and organizational impact to build something genuinely differentiated.

About The Team

The Content and Customer Advocacy team sits at the center of Zoom's marketing engine, shaping the stories, strategies, and digital experiences that connect Zoom's brand with its most important audiences. Lead the end-to-end customer review strategy across Gartner Peer Insights, TrustRadius, and G2, shifting from episodic award-driven solicitations to a strategic, always-on program that drives market proof and competitive differentiation.

Are you ready to make a lasting impact and transform the healthcare space? We are one of Southern California’s fastest-growing Medicare Advantage plans with an incredible 112% year-over-year membership growth.

Who Are We? ✨

Clever Care was created to meet the unique needs of the diverse communities we serve. Our innovative benefit plans combine Western medicine with holistic Eastern practices, offering benefits that align with our members’ culture and values.

Why Join Us? 🏆

We’re on a mission! Our rapid growth reflects our commitment to making healthcare accessible for underserved communities. At Clever Care, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real difference, shape the future of healthcare, and be part of a fast-moving, game-changing organization that celebrates diversity and innovation.

Job Summary

The Enterprise Project Manager is responsible for partnering with management, executive sponsors, and cross-functional leaders to define project objectives, scope, requirements, timelines, deliverables, and success measures for enterprise initiatives. This role leads the planning, coordination, and implementation of highly visible projects that advance Clever Care’s strategic priorities, strengthen enterprise infrastructure, improve operational performance, and support measurable business outcomes. Projects may be broad in scope and involve significant process development, change management, financial, information systems, regulatory, and organizational impacts across multiple departments.

The Enterprise Project Manager oversees multiple tactical and strategic projects from initiation through completion and benefits realization, ensuring work is delivered within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations. Working with limited supervision, this position applies sound judgment, project management discipline, and appropriate tools and project management and Six Sigma methodologies to manage risks, resolve issues, facilitate stakeholder alignment, and drive accountability. The role also supports the development and institutionalization of project management standards, lean processes, and continuous improvement practices across the organization to improve operational effectiveness, member and patient outcomes, and overall business results.

Functions & Job Responsibilities

Lead highly visible, sensitive, and cross-functional enterprise projects from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, scope, timelines, budget, quality standards, and expected outcomes.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, including milestones, tasks, dependencies, deliverables, target completion dates, action items, and project tracking tools or boards.
Coordinate project execution by assigning deliverables, monitoring progress, facilitating design and implementation reviews, resolving issues, and ensuring project work remains on schedule and within scope.
Establish consistent project tracking, reporting, and governance practices, including status updates, dashboards, reporting cadence, meeting agendas, minutes, and executive-level communications.
Develop KPIs, metrics, and success measures to evaluate project and program deliverables, monitor performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
Partner with data analysts and business stakeholders to define business questions, analyze data, identify gaps, and translate findings into meaningful recommendations, action plans, and process improvements.
Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and barriers by identifying mitigation strategies, monitoring progress, escalating concerns appropriately, and driving timely resolution.
Facilitate stakeholder alignment across departments by leading discussions, building professional relationships, promoting collaboration, and supporting effective communication across business units.
Provide project leadership, direction, coaching, and support to multidisciplinary project teams, internal stakeholders, and outside consultants to ensure goals, expectations, and objectives are met.
Support strategy development and change management by preparing presentations, policies and procedures, workflow documents, training materials, and other standard business communications for various audiences.
Develop, document, and improve operational frameworks, workflows, and lean processes within business units to enhance efficiency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Facilitate project, information-sharing, tracking, and conflict-resolution meetings to monitor team progress, address challenges, and maintain accountability.
Maintain project documentation, lessons learned, best practices, and key stakeholder updates to support transparency, knowledge sharing, and organizational learning.
Exercise sound judgment, creativity, and flexibility in applying appropriate project management methodologies, tools, techniques, and process improvement practices to meet project needs.
Manage quality initiatives and other assigned enterprise projects that support operational effectiveness, regulatory readiness, member outcomes, and business performance.
Perform other related duties as assigned.

By way of leadership approach, mobilize others to create extraordinary results, and unite people to turn challenges into successes by championing the following:

Encourage the Heart

Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​

Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Systems Integration & Validation
jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

Delivering a validation-ready vehicle depends on translating validation intent into a correctly integrated, fit-for-use asset (LabCar and its surrogates) across DREs, NPI/Supply, RVT, and Special Projects, with V&V owning the integrity of that translation.

As a Staff Technical Program Manager, Validation Software, you will own the operational execution of this integration layer across R1, R2, and EDV Pre-DV asset governance — simultaneously, not one program at a time. You will run the BOM/MPL-to-device reconciliation workstream, hold the cross-functional handshake between Validation, DRE/Device Teams, NPI, RVT, and Special Projects, and drive the fit-for-use decision that gates FM3-demonstrable evidence into DVB. You are accountable for consistent execution of this model across every program running it in parallel — not just for any single program's outcome. This is a working, hands-on TPM role inside a governance function that is scaling — you will help build the process as much as run it.

Responsibilities

Own the BOM/MPL → device → asset translation workstream: reconcile validation intent, software maturity, and released or surrogate device content into a single integrated asset demand, in partnership with DREs and Device Teams.
Own execution consistency across the full platform of simultaneous Pre-DV programs (R1, R2, EDV) — apply the same governance model, definitions, and fit-for-use bar whether one program or several are running in parallel, and surface and resolve process drift between programs before it becomes divergent practice.
Run the pre-DV asset R&R model day to day — the handshake between Validation/Feature (intent), V&V (integration + governance), NPI/Supply (device delivery), RVT (functional build), and Special Projects (physical build) — and keep each accountability distinct and current.
Track and drive closure on DRE responsibilities: surrogate or released part readiness, technical function/data content, early flagging of form-fit-function deviation, and transmittal data traceable to the correct end devices.
Host and facilitate the pre-DV cross-functional reviews to negotiate production-intent, sourcing, and timing gaps before DVB.
Maintain visibility into asset and device readiness against program milestones, and escalate maturity or timing mismatches to Vehicle Line and program leadership before they become launch risks.
Support the fit-for-use decision: confirm intended validation is supported, the LabCar functions, and the physical build works, before FM3-demonstrable evidence is claimed.
Build and maintain dashboards/metrics for asset governance status (RAG-style tracking across sourcing, delivery, negotiation, and governance), and provide clear, data-backed updates to senior stakeholders.
Contribute to scaling this governance model as the team grows — turning working practice into repeatable process, templates, and RACI as headcount and program count increase.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
Typically 5–8+ years of experience in automotive or complex electro-mechanical products, including significant experience in technical program management, systems engineering, or validation/test asset planning.
Working knowledge of BOM/MPL structures, device or part transmittal processes, and how pre-production surrogate parts differ from production-intent parts.
Demonstrated experience coordinating across engineering, program, NPI/supply chain, and build/test teams to resolve part, device, or asset delivery gaps under time pressure.
Comfortable operating with ambiguity in a governance model that is still being defined — able to drive clarity on R&R without waiting for it to be handed down.
Strong fluency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and dashboarding tools to drive decisions, not just report status.
Proven ability to influence across functions and levels, and to facilitate cross-functional alignment (e.g., a deviation/negotiation forum) without formal authority over every party in the room.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $154,000 - $192,500 for California based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The salary range for this role is $140,600 - $175,800 for Michigan based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). There is no fixed deadline for this application; applications are accepted on an ongoing basis until the role is filled or the opening is no longer needed.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com.

Candidate Data Privacy and Technology

Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

Job Description

Oracle is committed to achieving its sustainability goals and ensuring accurate, compliant reporting. Oracle’s Global Sustainability Office is seeking a versatile and strategic Principal Program Manager to drive sustainability initiatives and other duties as assigned. The ideal candidate will have experience in data center water conservation and stewardship with the ability to set holistic strategies while executing tactical priorities. This role will be critical in aligning cross-functional teams, improving data governance, and ensuring high-quality sustainability reporting.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own and drive corporate strategy, reporting, and metrics for water risk, conservation, and stewardship.
Partner with diverse teams to develop and refine processes for measuring, reporting, and improving performance.
Drive external partnerships and project management for strategic water stewardship and replenishment work.
Guide readiness for evolving sustainability reporting requirements, ensuring data integrity, auditability, and efficient response to both voluntary and regulatory disclosure frameworks.
Identify and analyze risks and opportunities in water management, surfacing actionable insights to inform business strategy.
Analyze sustainability-related data to identify inefficiencies, surface insights, and define relevant targets.
Support cross-company engagement and training programs to build awareness and adoption of sustainability best practices.
Interface as needed with customers and external stakeholders on key environmental topics, ensuring Oracle’s sustainability programs meet the expectations of customers, communities, and regulators.

Basic Qualifications

Extensive program and project management in sustainability, compliance, or ESG-related roles.
Demonstrated expertise in corporate water stewardship and driving water efficiency and replenishment projects .
Familiarity with water risk assessments, with the ability to translate global strategy into local priorities.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills at all levels, including executive leadership.
Comfort in ambiguity and flexing into unfamiliar domains to frame problems and drive execution.
Proven ability to develop and execute policy, targets, and reporting for water and other environmental metrics.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, leveraging data-driven prioritization and decision-making.
Experience aligning sustainability initiatives with business strategy and customer needs.

Preferred Skills

Background in data center sustainability and operations is a plus.
Experience using relevant enterprise sustainability software tools (e.g., EPM, Watershed, Aqueduct, Waterplan, Workiva, SAP Sustainability Control Tower, etc.).
Ability to lead organizational change and streamline complex processes in a dynamic business environment.
Understanding of major environmental data and reporting standards (e.g., ESRS/CSRD, CDP, GRI, GHGP, TCFD).
Familiarity with Oracle Fusion cloud applications, specifically Enterprise Performance Manager (EPM), Oracle Fusion ERP and SCM Applications.
Experience developing or advancing corporate biodiversity strategy, including assessment of impacts, goal setting, and alignment with emerging biodiversity frameworks.

jobs.title: Development and Project Manager, Finance
jobs.description:
Founded in 1909, Mehiläinen is a rapidly growing healthcare company that strongly invests in the possibilities of digitalisation and innovation. We are on a journey towards an ambitious goal: to be the leading healthcare company in Europe by 2030. Our growth story has already taken us to seven countries.

We are now looking for a Development and Project Manager, Finance
to join our Finance team, based in Helsinki, Kamppi. Someone who works at the intersection of finance, technology and business development, and who can turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions. This work takes place in a dynamic environment, as Mehiläinen completes several acquisitions every year, also abroad, and operates across multiple countries.

In this role you will participate finance system and process development initiatives, at Group level, involving our core finance systems and platforms. You combine a strong understanding of accounting processes and internal controls with hands-on expertise in finance system development, automation, integrations, data analytics and AI. You will drive efficiency through AI across part of the finance functions.

Key responsibilities

Manage global enterprise transformation programs involving D365 F&O, business process harmonization, and complex multi-vendor environments.
Manage finance system development, API and integration projects, from requirements definition through testing and implementation.
Drive process automation using for example Power Platform, UiPath StudioX and other tools, reducing manual work and improving data quality and controls.
Drive efficiency through AI — designing, building and implementing AI-driven solutions, including agents in the D365 environment, to automate and improve finance processes.
Act as AI Product Owner for the finance area — defining, prioritising and owning key AI development initiatives.
Improve the efficiency of finance support functions across all countries we operate in, for example by streamlining accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
Ensure prioritisation of the development portfolio based on impact and feasibility, and measure the benefits of development initiatives (time savings, automation levels, accuracy and reduced error).
Support the Finance organisation in the implementation and adoption of new tools and improved processes.
Contribute to finance system and process roll-outs in acquired companies — and take the project manager role on individual roll-outs.

You act as a bridge between finance professionals, business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors — from requirements and process design through testing, implementation and continuous development. This is an internationally oriented role with including also travelleing to our other countries of operation when needed.

Scope of impact

Geographic reach:
Mehiläinen operates in seven countries and completes several acquisitions every year — your development work spans finance processes and systems internationally, not just in Finland.
Organizational reach:
as a Group-level role, your solutions and initiatives reach finance and support functions in every country we operate in.
Stakeholder network:
you collaborate closely with finance professionals, Controllers, IT teams, business stakeholders and external vendors across a complex multi-vendor environment.
Depth of influence:
as AI Product Owner for finance, you define and drive the group-wide direction for automation and AI initiatives in finance — shaping how the function works, not just executing individual projects.

Requirements

In this Development and Project Manager role you combine strong project, process and stakeholder-management capabilities with solid technical understanding of financial systems, in order to translate business needs into practical, technical solutions.
Demonstrated experience in development work, having previously led development initiatives or projects.
Strong understanding of accounting processes and internal controls.
Proven track record of implementing AI-driven solutions in a finance or business context.
Hands-on expertise in finance system development; automation, integrations, data analytics and AI.
Experience with finance systems such as D365 F&O and Rillion Prime
Excellent Excel skills.
Experience with process automation and tools such as Power Platform or UiPath StudioX and ability to build solutions such as agents in the D365 environment.
Fluent English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.
Relevant higher education degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Economics and Business Administration).
The ability to work in a constantly changing environment across multiple development initiatives at the same time — you don't wait for ready-made assignments but identify development opportunities yourself and drive them forward.

Personal success factors

Credible, trustworthy presence — you build confidence with stakeholders across the organisation and in acquired companies.
Self-driven and proactive — you advance initiatives on your own, without waiting to be asked.
Growth mindset — you enjoy challenges and embrace opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
Hands-on, can-do attitude — you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take ownership.
Comfort with ambiguity — you make pragmatic decisions even under pressure.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality and outcomes.
Collaborative spirit that brings out the best in people around you.

Why join Mehiläinen?

We are all committed to acting in line with our values, and we believe the best results come from giving our experts freedom, responsibility, community and opportunities to grow. This Development and Project Manager role offers an opportunity to drive a broad, Group-level Finance development agenda and contribute to more efficient, scalable and AI-driven processes, systems and ways of working across all our countries of operation, with a strong focus on delivering measurable business value through transformation.

We offer you the opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions in a challenging, internationally oriented role, alongside a professional and supportive team. You can enjoy a variety of activities to balance work life, and have the opportunity to work flexibly in a hybrid setup.

Apply now

Send your application via the link below by 14.10.2026.
We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to interview during the application period. Please note that we do not accept applications by email. Work starts per agreement.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of complex digital and enterprise SaaS implementations for Radancy customers. This role will manage implementations across the Radancy Talent Acquisition Cloud, including Career Sites, CRM, Events, and Screening & Scheduling, from discovery and planning through configuration, integration, testing and launch.

Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams including Product, Product Engineering, Solutions Architecture, UX, Content and QA, the Senior Project Manager will provide strong leadership across multiple concurrent implementations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope and to agreed quality standards.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations, involving complex digital platforms, integrations and multiple stakeholders. They will bring strong project management discipline, excellent customer-facing communication and the ability to navigate technical complexity and changing priorities.

What does a great Senior Project Manager do?

Project Ownership & Delivery

Lead end-to-end implementations across the Radancy Talent Acquisition Cloud, including Career Sites, CRM, Events, and Screening & Scheduling.
Manage multiple complex enterprise projects and workstreams, overseeing scope, timelines, budgets, resources, dependencies and deliverables.
Lead projects through discovery, requirements, solution design, configuration, integration, QA, UAT and launch.
Develop and maintain project plans, estimates, SOWs, timelines and RAID logs.
