new_jobs.title: Development and Project Manager, Finance
new_jobs.description:
Founded in 1909, Mehiläinen is a rapidly growing healthcare company that strongly invests in the possibilities of digitalisation and innovation. We are on a journey towards an ambitious goal: to be the leading healthcare company in Europe by 2030. Our growth story has already taken us to seven countries.

We are now looking for a Development and Project Manager, Finance
to join our Finance team, based in Helsinki, Kamppi. Someone who works at the intersection of finance, technology and business development, and who can turn business requirements into scalable technical solutions. This work takes place in a dynamic environment, as Mehiläinen completes several acquisitions every year, also abroad, and operates across multiple countries.

In this role you will participate finance system and process development initiatives, at Group level, involving our core finance systems and platforms. You combine a strong understanding of accounting processes and internal controls with hands-on expertise in finance system development, automation, integrations, data analytics and AI. You will drive efficiency through AI across part of the finance functions.

Key responsibilities

Manage global enterprise transformation programs involving D365 F&O, business process harmonization, and complex multi-vendor environments.
Manage finance system development, API and integration projects, from requirements definition through testing and implementation.
Drive process automation using for example Power Platform, UiPath StudioX and other tools, reducing manual work and improving data quality and controls.
Drive efficiency through AI — designing, building and implementing AI-driven solutions, including agents in the D365 environment, to automate and improve finance processes.
Act as AI Product Owner for the finance area — defining, prioritising and owning key AI development initiatives.
Improve the efficiency of finance support functions across all countries we operate in, for example by streamlining accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
Ensure prioritisation of the development portfolio based on impact and feasibility, and measure the benefits of development initiatives (time savings, automation levels, accuracy and reduced error).
Support the Finance organisation in the implementation and adoption of new tools and improved processes.
Contribute to finance system and process roll-outs in acquired companies — and take the project manager role on individual roll-outs.

You act as a bridge between finance professionals, business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors — from requirements and process design through testing, implementation and continuous development. This is an internationally oriented role with including also travelleing to our other countries of operation when needed.

Scope of impact

Geographic reach:
Mehiläinen operates in seven countries and completes several acquisitions every year — your development work spans finance processes and systems internationally, not just in Finland.
Organizational reach:
as a Group-level role, your solutions and initiatives reach finance and support functions in every country we operate in.
Stakeholder network:
you collaborate closely with finance professionals, Controllers, IT teams, business stakeholders and external vendors across a complex multi-vendor environment.
Depth of influence:
as AI Product Owner for finance, you define and drive the group-wide direction for automation and AI initiatives in finance — shaping how the function works, not just executing individual projects.

Requirements

In this Development and Project Manager role you combine strong project, process and stakeholder-management capabilities with solid technical understanding of financial systems, in order to translate business needs into practical, technical solutions.
Demonstrated experience in development work, having previously led development initiatives or projects.
Strong understanding of accounting processes and internal controls.
Proven track record of implementing AI-driven solutions in a finance or business context.
Hands-on expertise in finance system development; automation, integrations, data analytics and AI.
Experience with finance systems such as D365 F&O and Rillion Prime
Excellent Excel skills.
Experience with process automation and tools such as Power Platform or UiPath StudioX and ability to build solutions such as agents in the D365 environment.
Fluent English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.
Relevant higher education degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Economics and Business Administration).
The ability to work in a constantly changing environment across multiple development initiatives at the same time — you don't wait for ready-made assignments but identify development opportunities yourself and drive them forward.

Personal success factors

Credible, trustworthy presence — you build confidence with stakeholders across the organisation and in acquired companies.
Self-driven and proactive — you advance initiatives on your own, without waiting to be asked.
Growth mindset — you enjoy challenges and embrace opportunities to develop both professionally and personally.
Hands-on, can-do attitude — you are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take ownership.
Comfort with ambiguity — you make pragmatic decisions even under pressure.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for quality and outcomes.
Collaborative spirit that brings out the best in people around you.

Why join Mehiläinen?

We are all committed to acting in line with our values, and we believe the best results come from giving our experts freedom, responsibility, community and opportunities to grow. This Development and Project Manager role offers an opportunity to drive a broad, Group-level Finance development agenda and contribute to more efficient, scalable and AI-driven processes, systems and ways of working across all our countries of operation, with a strong focus on delivering measurable business value through transformation.

We offer you the opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions in a challenging, internationally oriented role, alongside a professional and supportive team. You can enjoy a variety of activities to balance work life, and have the opportunity to work flexibly in a hybrid setup.

Send your application via the link below by 14.10.2026.
We review applications on a rolling basis and invite selected candidates to interview during the application period. Please note that we do not accept applications by email. Work starts per agreement.

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of complex digital and enterprise SaaS implementations for Radancy customers. This role will manage implementations across the Radancy Talent Acquisition Cloud, including Career Sites, CRM, Events, and Screening & Scheduling, from discovery and planning through configuration, integration, testing and launch.

Working closely with customers and cross-functional teams including Product, Product Engineering, Solutions Architecture, UX, Content and QA, the Senior Project Manager will provide strong leadership across multiple concurrent implementations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope and to agreed quality standards.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience leading enterprise SaaS implementations, involving complex digital platforms, integrations and multiple stakeholders. They will bring strong project management discipline, excellent customer-facing communication and the ability to navigate technical complexity and changing priorities.

What does a great Senior Project Manager do?

Project Ownership & Delivery

Lead end-to-end implementations across the Radancy Talent Acquisition Cloud, including Career Sites, CRM, Events, and Screening & Scheduling.
Manage multiple complex enterprise projects and workstreams, overseeing scope, timelines, budgets, resources, dependencies and deliverables.
Lead projects through discovery, requirements, solution design, configuration, integration, QA, UAT and launch.
Develop and maintain project plans, estimates, SOWs, timelines and RAID logs.
Establish clear project governance, ownership and accountability across internal and customer teams.
Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies that could impact delivery.
Ensure projects are successfully launched and transitioned into ongoing support.

Digital & Technical Delivery

Partner with Product, Product Engineering, Solutions Architecture, UX, QA and Content to deliver complex digital and SaaS implementations.
Manage integrations with enterprise HR and talent technology ecosystems, including ATS, HRIS, APIs, data feeds and third-party platforms.
Ensure requirements and technical dependencies are understood, documented and translated into clear delivery plans.
Lead customers and project teams through technical discovery, testing, UAT, defect resolution and launch readiness.
Maintain a strong understanding of Radancy’s platform and products to confidently manage implementation discussions and dependencies.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Act as a senior point of contact for customers throughout implementation, building strong relationships with project sponsors, technical stakeholders and operational teams.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies and decisions clearly and proactively.
Lead customer status meetings, workshops and implementation reviews.
Manage challenging conversations around scope, priorities, timelines and change while maintaining strong customer relationships.

Risk, Quality & Optimization

Identify project risks early and establish clear mitigation and escalation plans.
Ensure adherence to quality, accessibility, usability and web standards.
Manage project budgets, scope and timelines, taking corrective action where required.
Manage scope changes through appropriate change-control processes.
Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, tools and ways of working.
Support and mentor other Project Managers where appropriate.

new_jobs.title: Lead Program Manager, Returnable Container Operations & Logistics
new_jobs.description:
About Rivian

Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract.

As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations.

Role Summary

Rivian is seeking a highly motivated, floor-focused, and strategically minded Lead Program Manager, Returnable Container Operations & Logistics to architect, direct, and oversee the end-to-end physical lifecycle, strategy, and execution of our reusable packaging and container fleet. This is not a traditional, desk-bound corporate PM role. As a Lead, you will serve as the ultimate subject matter expert and senior escalation point, actively bridging shop floor reality with external partner accountability to ensure our manufacturing facilities have 100% container availability to support production. You will have primary operational and financial authority over our 3rd-Party Logistics (3PL) container management vendor, acting as the strategic liaison between component suppliers, the 3PL, and executive internal teams. Your mission is to drive overarching fleet optimization strategy, establish strict enterprise-wide maintenance and cleaning protocols, design systems to minimize loss, and champion circular economy practices across our supply chain. This role requires leading by example on the floor and mentoring cross-functional peers, and will be onsite in Normal, IL.

Responsibilities

Fleet Maintenance, Quality & Asset Control

Cleaning & Process Governance: Architect, implement, and govern the standardized processes for cleaning returnable packaging. Set enterprise-wide quality standards, specific procedural steps, and strict cleaning cadences.
Preventative Maintenance (PM) Strategy: Design and oversee the strategic rollout of preventative maintenance schedules for all existing and new returnable packaging assets. Lead this initiative from the front, setting the standard for rigorous cadences to maximize asset lifecycle and ROI.
Systemic Asset Control: Direct and optimize comprehensive internal and external (parts suppliers) physical asset counts. Develop systemic processes for these intervals (quarterly/semi-annual) to maintain absolute inventory integrity, proactively identify shrinkage trends, and eliminate fleet loss.

Shop Floor Operations & Continuous Improvement

Gemba Leadership & Floor Presence: Maintain a commanding daily presence on the production and warehouse floor. Act as a senior operational leader to directly observe container utilization, identify systemic bottlenecks, and drive cross-functional process improvements face-to-face with Plant Operations and Material Supply leadership.
Data-Driven Optimization: Leverage advanced data analytics to architect a predictive, proactive container planning model, transitioning the network away from reactive "shortage response." Set the benchmark for auditing physical container flows to validate and refine systemic data.

3PL Vendor & Supplier Accountability

Vendor Strategy & Enforcement: Command overall operational and cost accountability for the 3rd-party container operations vendor (3PL). Steer strategic vendor relationships and aggressively track performance against strict SLAs regarding container sorting, cleaning, maintenance, and dispatching.
Root Cause & Systemic Compliance: Lead complex root-cause analyses for critical supply chain issues and serve as the final authority on escalations. Design and enforce overarching chargeback mechanisms for component suppliers regarding lost, damaged, or misused assets.
Financial & TCO Leadership: Direct financial strategy by auditing 3PL billing, dwell times, and inventory accuracy to optimize total cost of ownership (TCO). Champion strategic loop optimizations to drive significant, measurable improvements in CapEx/OpEx budgets.

Cross-Functional Program Management

NPI & Logistics Architecture: Steer the strategic partnership with Packaging Engineering during new product introductions (NPI) to ensure global/regional packaging designs translate seamlessly into highly efficient, scalable, and repeatable logistical loops.
Line-Stoppage Prevention: Champion enterprise alignment between Material Planning, Logistics, and Plant Operations to seamlessly synchronize container return loops with dynamic production schedules, ensuring zero downtime and mitigating risk at the highest level.

Work Environment & Physical Presence

On-Site Requirement: This is a 100% on-site role based out of our Normal, IL manufacturing facility.
Active Floor Auditing: Candidates must be comfortable splitting their time between high-level strategic planning in a professional office environment and leading active, hands-on audits and investigations of container flows on the high-activity warehouse and manufacturing shop floors.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent years of experience in lieu of education).
Experience: 6+ years of experience (with proven experience in a leadership or senior strategic capacity) specifically focused on returnable asset management, container fleet logistics, or industrial packaging operations—ideally within the automotive, EV, or heavy manufacturing industries. (General project/program management experience without specific container/returnable asset management experience will not be considered).
Vendor Governance: Proven track record of strategically managing complex 3PL vendors, driving contract negotiations/enforcement, and holding external partners accountable to stringent physical maintenance, cleaning, and sorting KPIs.
Leadership: Demonstrated ability to influence leadership, champion large-scale strategic initiatives, and guide cross-functional floor teams without relying on formal reporting lines.
Systems Fluency: Advanced proficiency with ERP/WMS systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), Asset Tracking software (RFID/GPS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), and enterprise data analytics tools (Tableau, PowerBI).

Preferred Attributes

Experience architecting preventative maintenance (PM) or quality control loops from the ground up for industrial dunnage and returnable racks.
Deep, authoritative understanding of automotive dunnage, returnable racks, and standard AIAG packaging guidelines.
Exceptional executive communication and negotiation skills; ability to influence plant leadership and hold massive external suppliers accountable to strict compliance standards.

Pay Disclosure

The salary range for this role is $102,300 - $127,900 for Illinois based applicants. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs.

The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits for full-time and part-time employees, their spouse or domestic partner, and children up to age 26, including but not limited to paid vacation, paid sick leave, and a competitive portfolio of insurance benefits including life, medical, dental, vision, short-term disability insurance, and long-term disability insurance to eligible employees. You may also have the opportunity to participate in Rivian’s 401(k) Plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program if you meet certain eligibility requirements. Full-time employee coverage is effective on their first day of employment. Part-time employee coverage is effective the first of the month following 90 days of employment. More information about benefits is available at rivianbenefits.com.

You can apply for this role through careers.rivian.com (or through internal-careers-rivian.icims.com if you are a current employee). This job is not expected to be closed until filled.

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Application Close Date

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

This role is part of Blue Origin corporate functions, providing centralized support across Blue Origin business unit teams, functions, and locations.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. Join our diverse team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight.

This role is part of Blue Origin Corporate Functions on the Finance AI & BI team and will be on-site in Renton, Washington with relocation provided.

We are seeking a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to own the strategy and roadmap for the suite of BI tools supporting Finance and Accounting, including capital, labor, and inventory/production reporting today, with the expectation that this portfolio will grow. This is a senior, high-autonomy role: you will set direction for how existing tools evolve, lead build-vs-integrate decisions with Enterprise Technology (ET) and other cross-functional partners, and identify where new BI tools should be built to close reporting or controls gaps as the business scales. You will also mentor other analysts and represent Finance and Accounting BI needs in broader enterprise data and systems discussions.

Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Own the execution of Finance and Accounting's BI tool portfolio, currently including Capital Management and In-Servicing, Labor Reporting, and Production web application with expansion to new tools as reporting or controls needs are identified
Partner with ET to determine what logic belongs in business intelligence vs. source systems and lead automation of inventory reconciliations and costing sheet rate monitoring
Lead the design of automated logic, using transaction detail and accounting guidance to flag and correct transactions, and drive upstream error-prevention to reduce reliance on manual corrections
Identify gaps in existing Finance and Accounting reporting and lead the design and build of new BI tools to address them
Set priorities for the BI roadmap with Finance, Accounting, and ET leadership, and represent Finance and Accounting BI needs in enterprise data governance discussions
Mentor and provide technical guidance to other BI analysts and supporting their development

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or Data Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field
8+ years in business intelligence or systems analysis, ideally supporting a Finance or Accounting function
Demonstrated experience owning BI tool strategy and roadmap with full autonomy, including building new tools or reporting solutions from the ground up
Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent, and advanced SQL knowledge
Working knowledge of cost accounting concepts (e.g., capital projects, labor allocation, or inventory costing), with the ability to quickly learn Blue Origin-specific policies and processes
Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders, and mentoring other analysts

Strong working knowledge of cost accounting concepts, particularly capital project accounting or manufacturing cost accounting
Familiarity with ERP/cloud data platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365, OneStream, Databricks, etc) and proficiency with Python or R for automation/advanced analytics
Experience with data warehousing, ETL workflow design, or applying AI/ML to automate error detection at scale
Experience driving enterprise-wide data governance or standardization initiatives

WA applicants is $145,188.00 - $203,263.20

Position Summary

A global consumer products company is seeking an International Sales & Business Analyst to support and develop business operations in assigned international markets. This role focuses on distributor management, sales growth, profitability analysis, business planning, and overall market development.

The position will work closely with international distributors and customers while analyzing sales performance, expenses, market trends, and business opportunities. International travel is required approximately once every two months, typically for about one week at a time.

Responsibilities

Manage and support business operations for assigned international markets, including distributor relationships, sales growth, and profitability.
Communicate with customers and distributors regarding orders, pricing, inventory, product distribution, and sales activities.
Monitor sales and inventory levels and identify opportunities to improve business performance.
Develop and support country-level business plans and annual sales and expense budgets.
Analyze sales performance, expenses, profitability, market trends, and business opportunities.
Prepare sales reports, forecasts, presentations, and business analyses for management.
Conduct market research and store visits to evaluate competitors, products, pricing, distribution, and market opportunities.
Attend international trade shows and industry events.
Coordinate with marketing agencies and internal teams on promotional activities.
Support new product research and development through market information and customer feedback.
Support international trade and logistics activities, including import/export procedures, shipment coordination, and documentation.
Research local requirements related to product registration, importation, labeling, and other regulatory matters.
Provide translation and other business support as needed.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Economics, Analytics, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in sales, business analysis, sales operations, or a related field.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret sales and business data.
Effective written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
Willingness to travel internationally approximately one week every two months to South America.

Preferred Requirements

Spanish language skills preferred, but not required.
Knowledge of international trade and import/export processes.
Experience analyzing sales, expenses, profitability, and overall business performance.

USD31.25-33.65 per hour, depending on experience. Full-time, Non-Exempt position.

Benefits

Health, dental, and vision insurance
Life and disability insurance
Retirement savings plan
Paid time off and holidays
Professional development and career growth opportunities

LOCATION

Cypress, CA

Onsite, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM

International travel required approximately once every two months.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Tech and Product - USDS
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

About the team
Our team plays a crucial role in ensuring the company’s success. We seek people who are willing to learn and put in the effort to solve problems. Our challenges are not your regular day-to-day problems - you’ll be part of a team that’s developing new solutions to new challenges. It’s working fast, at scale, and we’re making a difference. We are looking for talents to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities
We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech and Product PMO team based in San Jose. You'll drive the end-to-end tasks that keep the systems behind TikTok running and work with various team members to deliver best user experiences and highest-standard user privacy. As a TPM, you’ll be the bridge between various teams and drive collaboration tasks across teams.
- Work closely with global cross-functional teams from Product, Engineering, and Sales in the US and mandarin-speaking countries to drive the end-to-end delivery of new products, services, and/or features to market.
- Manage a variety of complex, cross-functional programs and lead all aspects of assigned programs delivery.
- Create and maintain the Roadmap for the teams by working with the respective Tech and Product leaders.
- Define the way of driving the programs and constantly find ways to improve the process in a data-driven manner.
- Prepare the project schedule, define the milestones, and be the owner of the collaboration process and tools.
- Track and report progress, identify and mitigate risks, and remove blockers.
- Ensure products and applications release to market smoothly.
- Mentor and help develop the team.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Must have a technical educational background, such as a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- 3 years of relevant work experience in project/program management or software development leadership.
- Must have at least 1 year of experience in each of the following: Leading Agile development processes, managing software development projects, including building development processes and coordinating release schedules, or creating and maintaining software development roadmaps for engineering teams.
- Managing stakeholder relationships and gathering feedback to build programs that support customer revenue, growth, and retention.
- Planning and executing projects using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
- Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
- Experience operating in fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities across time zones.
- Passion for problem-solving, process optimization, and delivering results in a data-driven and iterative way.
- Growth mindset with a willingness to take initiative and adapt in a constantly evolving environment.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

USDS Reasonable Accommodation

USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Job Information

【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)
The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $156800 - $403200 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Overview

REI Systems’ mission is to deliver reliable, innovative technology solutions that advance Federal clients' missions and exceed their expectations. Our technologists and consultants are passionate about solving complex challenges that impact millions of lives. We take a Mindful Modernization® approach in delivering our services, including application modernization, grants management, case management systems, government data analytics, and advisory services. This approach, the REI Way, ensures mission impact by aligning our clients' strategic objectives with measurable outcomes through people, processes, and technology.

We offer the same commitment to our employees by providing professional development, meaningful projects, and flexibility to spend time with family and friends. We believe employees are at their best when fulfilled in both their professional careers and their personal lives. Learn more at www.REIsystems.com.

Employees voted REI Systems a Washington Post Top Workplace in 2015, 2016, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025!

Responsibilities

Position Overview

REI Systems is seeking an experienced Business Analyst to support a large-scale FDA program
serving federal healthcare and public health missions. The Business Analyst will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, program leadership, Product Owners, technical teams, and end users to understand mission needs and translate them into clear, actionable business and technical requirements.

The ideal candidate is a highly collaborative and analytical professional who can work effectively in complex federal environments, facilitate discussions with diverse stakeholders, analyze current-state processes, define future-state capabilities, and support the successful delivery of secure, scalable, user-centered FDA solutions
.

This role requires the ability to understand both the business mission and the underlying technology, ensuring that solutions meet stakeholder needs, comply with federal standards, and deliver measurable improvements to program operations and user experience.

Responsibilities

Gather, analyze, and document business, functional, and system requirements.
Facilitate requirements sessions, stakeholder interviews, and working meetings.
Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, use cases, and business rules.
Translate business needs into clear requirements for development and technical teams.
Support Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
Partner with Product Owners, developers, QA, UX, architects, and program leadership throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Analyze current-state processes and recommend future-state improvements.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect review, and requirements validation.
Assist with data, reporting, dashboard, and integration requirements.
Identify opportunities for automation, AI-enabled solutions, and process modernization.
Maintain requirements traceability and ensure delivered solutions align with business needs.
Prepare status updates, documentation, presentations, and stakeholder communications.

Qualifications

Typically 5+ years of progressive Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or related experience, preferably supporting complex IT programs.
Experience supporting functional/UAT testing, including developing test scenarios, executing test cases, validating requirements, and documenting defects.
Ability to work closely with QA and development teams to ensure requirements are testable and solutions meet business expectations.
Demonstrated experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing complex business and system requirements.
Strong experience developing:
User stories
Acceptance criteria
Business requirements
Functional requirements
Process flows
Use cases
Requirements traceability documentation

Experience supporting Agile/Scrum software development teams.
Experience with business process analysis and process improvement.
Ability to facilitate requirements workshops involving business and technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences and business requirements for technical teams.
Experience working with development, architecture, QA, DevOps, UX/UI, and product management teams.
Experience supporting UAT, testing, defect triage, and requirements validation.
Proficiency with business analysis and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio, Lucidchart, Microsoft Office, SharePoint, or comparable platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working within a federal IT contracting or consulting environment.
Understanding of federal SDLC, Agile, DevSecOps, and digital modernization practices.
Experience supporting large-scale application modernization, cloud migration, or digital transformation initiatives.
Experience with healthcare data, healthcare workflows, case management systems, grants systems, regulatory applications, or public health platforms.
Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and concepts such as FHIR, HL7, APIs, and healthcare data exchange.
Experience working with cloud-based solutions in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or similar environments.
Experience supporting API, integration, microservices, or data modernization initiatives.
Experience using SQL or other tools to perform basic data analysis and validation.
Experience with dashboards and reporting solutions such as Power BI or Tableau.
Exposure to Generative AI, AI-assisted business processes, RPA, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Experience with Human-Centered Design (HCD), UX research, customer journey mapping, or user-centered product development.
Business analysis or Agile certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA, CSM, CSPO, SAFe, or equivalent are preferred.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

Strong customer and mission focus
Business and technical acumen
